description:
_project/scripts/soundness_drain_report.py carries its own copy of the single-context required-lane logic that green_unmerged_sweep.py shed in PR #1633: REQUIRED_CHECK_NAME = 'ci-required-result', required_lane_check_run() matching that one name, and is_required_lane_green() returning True from that single run. develop-squash-only has had TWO required status contexts since 2026-08-03 (ci-required-result and 'Results Explorer browser gate', per docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md), so the drain report can classify a PR required-lane green while its second required context is red or has never reported.

Second, subtler defect found while scoping: park_time_hours() anchors 'when did this PR go green' on the single check run's completed_at. Under two contexts the PR goes green when the LAST required context completes, so anchoring on ci-required-result overstates park time whenever the browser gate finishes later -- tripping the >24h drain gate early. Fixing the classifier without fixing the anchor leaves a live off-by-one-context bug.

Deliberately NOT extracting a shared helper module in this item: green_unmerged_sweep.py is in flight in unmerged PR #1633, so editing it here would either conflict or require a stacked PR (zero CI in this repo). Convergence is tracked separately once #1633 lands.

preserves.behavior: Report stays observation-only: it labels and files a digest, it never enables auto-merge
Soundness-gated PRs remain the population the report is ABOUT -- never invert the soundness exclusion borrowed from the sweep

verifications.description: Self-test passes offline against the bundled fixture
Report no longer keys on a single hardcoded context

REQUIRED_CHECK_NAMES tuple + latest_check_run/is_check_run_success; is_required_lane_green requires every context latest-success, missing runs fail closed. Ladder rung 2 (! rg -q 'REQUIRED_CHECK_NAME = ') exits 0.
work_units.summary: Require every ruleset context in is_required_lane_green (fail closed on missing runs)

work_units.evidence: required_lane_green_at() anchors park time on max(completed_at) across required contexts, falling back to updated_at when any stamp is missing. Fixture 9110: umbrella -52h, gate -10h => park 10.0h (too_young); old umbrella-only anchor read 52.0h and wrongly qualified. Negative-tested by reverting only the anchor: self-test and test_park_time_anchors_on_the_last_required_context both fail.
work_units.summary: Anchor park_time_hours on the last required context to complete

work_units.evidence: New tests/unit/scripts/test_soundness_drain_report.py (32 tests; script previously had none). Fixture PRs 9108 (gate absent) / 9109 (gate red) as not_green, 9110 for the anchor; existing PRs gained a gate completing before their umbrella so prior expectations are unchanged (verified additive-only). Ladder: self-test 10 PRs/3 qualifying exit 0; tests/unit/scripts/ 1628 passed.
work_units.summary: Fixture + unit tests for partial-green and park-time anchoring
